title: Ouija board warning of an Aboriginal uprising, taken to the Australian consulate

tellings.quote: At one point we were told there was going to be an Aboriginal uprising in Australia outside of Perth that was very specific.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history, says that in the mid-1960s in New York, a Ouija board, a lettered board people use to try to receive messages from spirits, gave him and others a very specific warning of an uprising by Aboriginal Australians outside Perth. As the title tells it, they took the warning to the Australian consulate, which, if true, would mean the board was passing on real-world predictions.
